title: THE ATTRACT TITLES READ OVER THE FOOTAGE
why: Seen on the first real attract clip (2026-10-09): PRESS ANY KEY sat right on the recorded belt caption and PILLAGERS on the recorded clock, both hard to read over the gameplay. Each now sits on a soft dark band, and PRESS ANY KEY is raised clear of the belt row in the clip.
now: On the title gameplay clip, PILLAGERS and PRESS ANY KEY now read clearly over the footage.
